title: Health checks: eject after several misses, re-admit after several passes
caption: Requiring consecutive failures stops one slow response from flapping a server in and out of the pool.

messages.label: GET /healthz (every 5 s)
messages.note: Active check: the LB polls a cheap endpoint on every server.

messages.label: GET /healthz → timeout ×3
messages.note: App 2 hangs. One timeout could be a blip; three in a row mark it unhealthy.

messages.label: eject App 2
messages.note: App 2 leaves the rotation. Its open requests are lost or retried elsewhere.

messages.label: forward
messages.note: New traffic only goes to healthy servers; the client never sees App 2's failure.

messages.label: 200 OK ×2 (recovered)
messages.note: After consecutive passes App 2 rejoins, ideally with a slow ramp-up so a cold server isn't flooded.
